intro.text: An eccentric, talkative soldier of the Kholinar Wall Guard, serving in Noro's squad.

items.text: When Kaladin joined Noro's squad, Beard took him for a fellow low-ranking lighteyes, befriended him and showed him how the Wall Guard worked. He was loyal to his post and to Highmarshal Azure, and kept her secrets.

Beard saw Kaladin kill a Fused on the walls, and simply grinned when Kaladin revealed himself as a Surgebinder with a Shardblade. At Kaladin's request, he and the squad were present when Azure revealed how the Wall Guard was being fed.

Beard was among the soldiers who went with Kaladin into Kholinar Palace to confront the queen and find Elhokar. In the fighting that followed he was run through with a spear by Sah, and Noro avenged him before falling himself.

appearance.text: Short, stocky and lighteyed, with hairy hands, but despite his nickname no beard at all.

personality.text: A lighteye of the tenth dahn, Beard scorns 'middlers', mocking a disguised Adolin's colourful clothes, and blames the city's decline on the queen's execution of Pai.
Beard at first seems to have no faith, refusing to wear a glyphward, but seeing Kaladin kill a Fused seems to restore it.

Beard talks constantly, telling outrageous stories of his own heroics and meetings with royalty. His squadmates mostly tell him to be quiet but like him well enough; he knows he annoys people and doesn't mind, and he reminds Kaladin of Lopen.
